### Run File Format Specification
Each line in your run file must contain exactly six columns:

| Column | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Topic ID** | The unique identifier for the query/topic. |
| **Q0** | A constant string literal "Q0". |
| **Docid** | The unique identifier of the retrieved document segment (e.g., `msmarco_v2.1_doc_...`). |
| **Rank** | The rank of the retrieved segment (integer, starting from 1). |
| **Score** | The retrieval score (float/double). Must be in non-increasing order. |
| **Run ID** | An identifier for your specific run/system (e.g., `bm25_baseline`). |

---

2027497 Q0 msmarco_v2.1_doc_51_766815931#2_1606878413 1 0.99986017 my_bm25_run
2027497 Q0 msmarco_v2.1_doc_51_766815931#1_1606876582 2 0.99966730 my_bm25_run

  --topics <path_to_topics_file> \
  --index <path_to_msmarco_v2.1_index> \
  --output run.bm25.txt \
  --bm25 \
  --output-format trec
